card.name: Word starts before vein-related words
card.fires_on: Partway through a word where the next piece is likely 'venous' or 'veined', such as intra-/intr- before 'avenous', IN-TR- before 'AVENOUS', Ret-inal before 'vein' or 'vasculitis', and pinn-ately before 'veined'.

modes.label: Before intravenous
modes.description: The start of 'intravenous' or 'intra-' where 'venous' is expected next.

modes.description: The word 'Retinal' before vein or vascular terms.

modes.label: Leaf veining
modes.description: The word 'pinnately' in plant descriptions, right before 'veined'.

card.writes: It promotes 've' and 'ven' pieces, setting up words like venous, vein and veined.
card.plain: It fires on word beginnings when a vein-related word like intravenous or veined is about to follow.
